text.p: Rietumu Bank, the fourth largest Latvian bank in terms of assets, said on Thursday that its 1996 profit before tax grew two times to 4.93 million lats versus 2.10 million lats in 1995.
Assets grew by 42.88 million lats or by 95 percent to 88.22 million lats and deposits increased to 76.82 million lats, an increase of 38.30 million lats, Rietumu said in a statement.
Rietumu said that among its main activities in 1997 will be the expanding of its network of branches, equity operations and individual service to big corporate clients.
Rietumu's capital adequacy ratio is 21 percent compared to the eight percent minimum, mandated by the Basel committee, which draws up rules for commercial banks all over the world.
Rietumu Bank said that its income in 1996 was determined by the introduction of new services.
It listed securities operations, service to corporate clients, payment cards, forex activities and credit provision.

Rietumu's loan portfolio increased to 7.49 million lats from 810,000 lats during 1996 mainly due to a higher volume of loans provided to businesses. The average profitability of loan operations was 20.38 percent.
